citation: Blegen, Carl William, and Marion Rawson, eds. 1966. The Palace of Nestor at Pylos in Western Messenia. Volume I: The Buildings and Their Contents. Published for the University of Cincinnati by Princeton University Press. Princeton Legacy Library reprint ISBN 9780691650265 (copyright 1966).
notes: Primary excavation report, University of Cincinnati expedition at Englianos (Messenia). Princeton University Press book page (accessed 2026-10-11): palace and lower town as administrative center of a prosperous Mycenaean kingdom; name Pylos on more than fifty tablets; destroyed by fire at the end of the 13th century B.C. and never reoccupied; annual campaigns 1952–1964 revealed a complex of four structures (throne room, storerooms, wine magazine, pantries, etc.). Tablets, seals, and frescoes reserved for other volumes. Seed uses only publisher-page statements; no invented page numbers from the printed volume.
